Own-ship must cross this fleet TWICE: once on their approach, again after they round. Correct: Rule 8 -- a single holistic plan with due regard to ALL vessels present, re-checked as each one rounds and re-threatens, not a per-contact reaction.
pass_criteria: Own-ship avoids collision with all 5 contacts.
